_readme: PER-WEEK data source for the WEEKLY Allure 'Fix failed cases' card. Filename MUST be crm-fix-failed-cases.<periodKey>.json (this one = 2026-W33); the weekly job reads ONLY the file matching the report's ISO week, so each week shows just its own fixes. To record a new week's fixes, COPY this file to the new periodKey name and edit its cases. Each object is one failed test case fixed that week. Fields: section (suite, e.g. O12_CE_to_O12_CC), summary (full test title 'TC-ID: title'), error (the failing assertion/message), foundDate + fixDate (ISO yyyy-mm-dd; leave fixDate empty '' while still in progress), solution (what fixed it). Errors/solutions left '' render as a 'to fill' placeholder.

cases.summary: CRM-12059_1.2: Verify merging a fresh contact into a historical contact with a Stage>=Activated Opp completes with no Qualification-info error
cases.error: TimeoutError: page.waitForURL: Timeout 240000ms exceeded - navigateToCRM never reached the CRM kanban view (HomePage.ts:123); run took 5m 21s before aborting
cases.solution: Two fixes. (1) HomePage.navigateToCRM waited on the URL glob '**/web?*view_type=kanban*', but since Playwright 1.45 '?' is a LITERAL character in URL globs, so the hash-only URL Odoo produces when CRM is re-entered from inside the SPA (/web#action=...view_type=kanban) never matched - a silent 240s timeout on every in-session re-entry. Replaced with the RegExp /\/web[?#].*view_type=kanban/ (CRM_KANBAN_URL), which covers both the post-login '/web?#...' and the in-SPA '/web#...' form. (2) Rewrote pre-condition 1: the historical contact is now PINNED (KooBra Software Enticklungs GmbH #348461) instead of being discovered by scanning up to 8 Activated Opps, and the merge is keyed on a SHARED EMAIL DOMAIN - the fresh source is created with buildEmailInDomain() inside the historical contact's domain, and the outcome is verified per record by its OWN email, not by name count.

cases.summary: CRM-12059_1.3: Verify merging a fresh contact into a historical contact with a Stage>=Won Opp completes with no Qualification-info error
cases.error: TimeoutError: page.waitForURL: Timeout 240000ms exceeded - navigateToCRM never reached the CRM kanban view (HomePage.ts:123); run took 5m 59s before aborting
cases.solution: Same root cause and same navigateToCRM fix as CRM-12059_1.2 (URL glob '?' is literal since Playwright 1.45 -> CRM_KANBAN_URL RegExp matching both '/web?#...' and '/web#...'). Pre-condition 1 additionally pinned to the historical Won contact Environmental Design International (#204921, @envdesigni.com) instead of scanning for a Won Opp, with the fresh source created inside that email domain and the merge outcome verified per record by its own email address.

cases.summary: CRM-12059_1.4: Verify merging a fresh contact into a historical contact with MULTIPLE Stage>=Activated Opps completes with no Qualification-info error
cases.error: Error: Merge must leave exactly one exact-name contact (the destination); found 2 - expect(received).toBe(expected), Expected: true, Received: false
cases.solution: The merge silently did nothing because the scenario keyed the two contacts on Company Name alone, and the outcome was verified by counting exact-name rows - a count that is meaningless when pre-prod holds several contacts with the same name. Reworked like 1.2/1.3: destination PINNED to KooBra Software Enticklungs GmbH (#348461, @koobra.de, 3 high-stage Opps), the fresh source created inside that email domain with buildEmailInDomain(), and the outcome verified per record by its OWN email (source rows -> 0, destination email still listed) instead of by exact-name count. Includes the shared navigateToCRM CRM_KANBAN_URL RegExp fix.
